newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court says Italy late to enact supply contract rules.
newsitem.headline: Court says Italy late to enact supply contract rules.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday Italy was late to enact Community rules on on the award of supply contracts under Council directive 93/36.
Italy did not deny the allegation by the European Commission, but stated the required measures would be adopted soon.

The court maintained its position that member states may not plead provisions, practices or circumstances existing in its internal legal system to justify a failure to comply with Community obligations.

1. Declares that, by failing to adopt within the prescribed period the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with Council directive 93/35/EEC coordinating procedures for the award of public supply contracts (OJ 1993 L 199, p.1) and by failing to notify those provisions, the Italian Republic has failed to fulfil its obligations under the first subparagraph of article 34(1) of that directive;
2. Dismisses the remainder of the application;
3. Orders the Italian Republic to pay the costs.
